---
applyTo: '_site/**'
---

# Generated artifact — do not edit

Every file under the artifact directory is machine-generated by the source project's
frontend renderer and imported by `scripts/sync-site.ps1`.

- Never edit, reformat, or lint these files. They must match the source byte for byte;
  the transfer script verifies this and will fail if they diverge.
- Never create files here by hand. Content is added by re-rendering in the source project
  and re-running the transfer.
- When something is wrong on the published site, fix it in the source project's frontend,
  re-render, and re-import. Report the defect and its likely source location instead of
  patching the output.
- Trailing whitespace, long lines, and unconventional formatting in these files are
  expected artifacts of the generator and are not defects.
